messages:
kari (PM): quick sync request — we need to lock the compatibility guarantees for onprem/VPC package 2.0. main items: agent protocol v1 deprecation timeline, customer-managed networking vars, and rollback UX. can we weigh tradeoffs?
angelo (Backend Eng): +1. my proposal: keep a compatibility shim that accepts v1 protocol for one major release (2.x) while emitting deprecation warnings. after that, remove. minimizes customer pain.
maya (Field Eng): from field: several regulated customers require explicit offline upgrade paths (airgapped). they want a migration tool that works without internet and can do a dry-run. also they asked for a flag to preserve hostnames vs. ip-binding when switching to VPC.
jordan (SRE): concerns: KV cache invalidation during upgrade can cause model-serving mismatches. need an ordered migration: drain, snapshot KV, upgrade, warm caches, and cutover. otherwise we see ~5-10% 5xx during rollouts.
angelo (Backend Eng): agree on ordered migration. we can add a compatibility header so new runtime knows to accept old KV encodings and migration step does transformation. example config snippet for shim mode:
```yaml
agent:
  compat_mode: legacy
  accept_v1_kv: true
  migration_transform: enabled
```
maya (Field Eng): that helps. also request: telemetry opt-in for airgapped customers so we can get upgrade success/failure signals via file-based reports (they can't call home).
lindsey (Solutions Eng): customers emphasized clear CLI and rollback instructions. propose adding `redwood migrate --check` and `redwood migrate --apply --offline` for airgapped. docs must include sample pre/post verification prompts for model behavior.
kari (PM): launch criteria proposal: (1) migration tool supports offline mode + dry-run, (2) upgrade path validated with 3 pilot customers (one enterprise, one gov, one mid-market), (3) compat shim for v1 enabled in 2.x, and (4) clear rollback UX (automated cache restore + explicit CLI). thoughts?
jordan (SRE): add performance SLOs: 95th percentile latency impact < 15% during canary; and automated rollback trigger on >1% 5xx or degraded prompt fidelity.
angelo (Backend Eng): implementation estimate: shim + transform ~2 weeks, CLI migration tool ~3 weeks, offline telemetry design ~1 week. need a small eng-oncall window for canary stages.
lindsey (Solutions Eng): from a customer comms POV, we need a migration checklist, sample scripts, and a runbook for the customer network team (IP allowlist, DNS cutover sequence). I'll draft the checklist if you own the runbook details.
maya (Field Eng): also include instructions for DB migrations (schema-only changes we do in-place, larger migrations we recommend side-by-side). airgap customers want the latter documented.
kari (PM): timeline idea: start implementation next sprint, internal canary at week 3, pilot customers week 6-8, GA week 12 if all green. sounds aggressive — open to push.
angelo (Backend Eng): realistic: shift GA to week 14 to allow extra pilot fixes.
jordan (SRE): we'll need a rolling canary plan and a quick revert playbook. add a step to validate KV checksum post-migration.
deply-bot (deploy-bot): pipeline created: onprem-2.0-canary (id: pipeline-9832) — triggered by branch `onprem/2.0-compat-shim`.
lindsey (Solutions Eng): +1 to extended timeline. customers prefer thorough pilots. also note legal needs to review telemetry file reports for gov customers.
kari (PM): action items: angelo to draft shim design + migration transform RFC by EOD Friday; maya to collect 2 pilot customer volunteers by Tues; lindsey to draft customer migration checklist; jordan to draft canary/revert runbook. i'll assemble decision doc and proposed launch criteria. tagging folks: @angelo @maya @lindsey @jordan — please ack and update your calendar invites. :thumbsup:
angelo (Backend Eng): ack — starting on RFC today.
maya (Field Eng): ack, will ping customers.
jordan (SRE): ack — will draft runbook.
lindsey (Solutions Eng): ack — will start checklist.
kari (PM): thanks all, i'll post the decision doc here once written.
